acts.title: The High Cascades
acts.blurb: Short summers and the Ash Warden.

twists.how: Every rival seat starts with param acorns.
The game lasts param turns per player (tile supply sized to match).
Nobody may use the free sweep of three matching tokens (four still sweep themselves).
You start with param acorns (a gentle head start).

intro.text: The Thawing Valley lost its wild things in the long frost. Let's start small.
Grow your own valley alone this time. Pairs of bears, lines of elk. Aim for 50 points.

outro.text: Fresh tracks in the snow. The valley remembers how to live.

opponent.name: The Frost
opponent.personality: No rival: just you against the season.
opponent.praise: The frost lets go. The valley is yours to grow.
opponent.taunt: The frost holds on. Try again next thaw.

easier.text: Same calm valley; the goal stays, every tip stays on.

intro.text: Hi! I'm restoring the next hollow. Shall we see whose valley grows better?
Pip takes what is closest. You start with 2 acorns: spend one when the pair you need is split up.

outro.text: Your hawks look so proud up there. Teach me sometime?

opponent.name: Pip
opponent.personality: Cheerful, takes whatever looks nice right now.
opponent.praise: Pip: You are really good at this! Teach me more?
opponent.taunt: Pip: Ha! Beginner's luck... I mean, my valley grew!

twist.text: Head start: you begin with 2 acorns (spend one to take any tile with any token).

intro.text: This valley was my family's before the frost. I'll not hand it to a newcomer.
Bram hoards acorns. Get some of your own: keystones!

outro.text: Fair is fair. The valley is yours to tend. I'll be watching.
The Thawing Valley breathes again. The Mistwood calls next.

opponent.name: Bram Hollowell
opponent.personality: Stubborn and careful. Starts with a pocket of acorns.
opponent.taunt: Back to the frost with you, newcomer.
opponent.praise: Hm. You know your bears. The claim is yours.

twist.text: Boss rule: Bram starts with 2 acorns.

easier.text: Bram plays gently and starts with no acorns.

intro.text: The Mistwood is thick. My meadows spread fast. Keep up, if you can.
Habitats pay too: big connected forests and rivers win bonuses.

outro.text: Your rivers run further than mine. Well grown.

opponent.name: Sorrel
opponent.personality: Builds huge habitats, careless with animals.
opponent.praise: Sorrel: Fair and square. Your meadows are the better ones.
opponent.taunt: Sorrel: The meadow chose me this time. Come back stronger.

intro.text: Three rangers, one spring, one market. It gets crowded.
With more rivals the best pairs vanish fast. Acorns let you choose freely.

outro.text: You read the market like birdsong.

opponent.name: Linnet
opponent.praise: Linnet: The birds liked your valley best. I heard them.
opponent.taunt: Linnet: My hawks found more room than yours. Next time?

intro.text: I survey valleys for a living. Yours will rank second, as they all do.
Quill never wastes a turn and keeps spare acorns. Beat her surveyed perfection.

outro.text: First rank. I will have to correct my maps.
The Mistwood is clear. Only the High Cascades remain, and the Warden there.

opponent.name: Sable Quill
opponent.personality: Precise and patient. Plans the market three turns ahead.

twist.text: Boss rule: Quill starts with 2 acorns.

easier.text: Quill plays at normal strength with no acorns.

intro.text: Up in the Cascades the summer is short. Only 16 turns before the snow returns.
Alone again. Every token counts. Reach 60.

outro.text: Even a short summer can be full of life.

opponent.name: The Snowline
opponent.personality: No rival: a short, hard season.
opponent.praise: The snowline creeps back up the peaks. Spring wins.
opponent.taunt: The snow comes early. The season closes on you.

goal.text: Score at least 60 points in 16 turns.

intro.text: These forests are older than your grandmother's grandmother. Prove you deserve them.
No sweeping the market here: the old growth keeps what it is given. New animal cards here.

outro.text: The old trees approve. So do I.

opponent.name: Oake
opponent.personality: Slow, wise, plays the long game.
opponent.praise: Oake: Old trees bow to a young ranger. Well grown.
opponent.taunt: Oake: Patience grows forests. You will learn it.

twist.text: Rule: nobody may sweep three tokens.

intro.text: Every ranger of the Cascades meets at the falls. Four valleys, one market.
No hard feelings if I take your hawks. New animal cards here.

outro.text: The council will follow your lead against the Warden.

opponent.name: Linnet
opponent.praise: Linnet: The birds liked your valley best. I heard them.
opponent.taunt: Linnet: My hawks found more room than yours. Next time?

easier.text: The rivals play at normal strength.

intro.text: I burned these slopes to keep them tidy. Wild things are untidy.
The Warden is strong, rich in acorns, and nobody may sweep the market. New animal cards here.

outro.text: Green again... perhaps untidy is better.
Three regions restored. You are a true ranger of the wild.

opponent.name: The Ash Warden
opponent.personality: Cold and exact. Starts with acorns; forbids sweeping.
opponent.taunt: Ash settles on another failed ranger.
opponent.praise: The fire is out. The valley is yours.

twist.text: Boss rule: the Warden starts with 3 acorns.

easier.text: The Warden plays at normal strength with no acorns.

prologue.note: Coached first game: Rowan speaks the first time each rule matters (coach[id]); rules that never came up are listed at the end. Max 2 short lines each.
prologue.endText: Rowan: That was a real game. The strip under your valley rated every move. Now the seasons are 20 turns long.

coach.goal: Bram wants this valley for timber. Out-score him in 6 turns and it stays wild. Each column shows "up to +N": the points it adds now. Pick one.
coach.place: Tiles must touch your valley. The +N on a glowing spot is what it scores. Tap one to see why, then Place.
coach.habitat: Matching edges join land. Each terrain scores 1 point per tile in your biggest joined group.
coach.rotate: This tile has two lands. Tap Turn until the edges match your valley, then Place.
coach.settle: Animals only live on a tile that shows them. The badge on each tile is its points. No good spot? Return it, no penalty.
coach.bear: Bears score in pairs: groups of exactly 2 touching bears. A third bear spoils the pair.
coach.elk: Elk score in straight lines. The longer the line, the more points.
coach.salmon: Salmon score in runs. Each salmon touches at most 2 others.
coach.hawk: Hawks like to be alone: each hawk touching no other hawk scores.
coach.fox: A fox scores 1 point for each different animal next to it.
coach.keystone: A gold-rimmed keystone! An animal settled here earns an acorn. An acorn is 1 point, or a favour now.
coach.acornSpend: You have an acorn. Tap "Use acorn" for a free pick of any tile and animal. Or replace the animals on offer.
coach.sweep3: Three alike in the market. You may sweep them for fresh animals, once per turn, for free.
coach.wipe4: Four alike: the market clears them by itself and deals new animals.
coach.rival: Bram's turn. Watch the caption: he takes, places and settles just like you.
coach.majority: Bigger habitat than Bram in a terrain? That terrain pays you a bonus: +2 (a tie gives both +1).
coach.final: The thaw. Here is how your score adds up, rule by rule.
coach.acornsEnd: Each acorn you still hold is 1 point.
coach.tiebreak: A tie goes to whoever has more acorns left. Still tied? You share the win.
coach.poor: That one scored nothing yet. Next time look for a spot that fits its card.

intro: A new season in the valley. Grow the wildest one.
The thaw is here. Bears, elk and foxes need homes.
Rangers are out early this year. Grow faster.
quick.win: Your valley is the wildest at the thaw.
quick.lose: Their valley ran wilder this season.
